Overview

This feature service provides a road network for Westbank First Nation and supports reference, navigation, and local transportation mapping within the community.

Feature Layer

  • WFN georoads: A line feature layer representing roads within Westbank First Nation. The layer includes road naming and address range attributes that support route reference, street labeling, and location-based mapping. 

Geographic Coverage

The service covers Westbank First Nation are within the Regional District of Central Okanagan, British Columbia.

Use Cases

  • Street and road reference mapping
  • Local address and route context
  • Transportation planning and maintenance support
  • Community mapping applications
